title: Why are Indian electricity poles covered in wires? 2,335 km of illegal cables in Bengaluru
description:
Most of the tangle on Indian street poles is not power. The power lines usually sit at the top; the black bundles below are cable TV, internet and optical fibre lines hung on electricity poles. In July 2024 BESCOM ordered operators to remove unauthorised cables by 8 July, and its survey counted about 2,335 km of illegal wires in Bengaluru alone.
Sources: BESCOM via PTI (6 Jul 2024), Deccan Herald (Jul 2024), The News Minute (May 2019). Educational content, not advice. AI visualisation in some shots.
